text.p: High temperatures of 90F or above will dominate much of the Plains, Midwest, and East in the USA through today. Across the Southwest desert regions will see temperatures near 120F in some locations. Heat-related problems are expected as a result of the widespread hot weather affecting many major cities.

Tropical Storm Danny, with 60 mph winds, is centered about 60 miles south of New Orleans, moving northeast at 6 mph. A tropical storm warning and hurricane watch is up from Morgan City, Louisiana, to Destin, Florida. Danny is expected to make landfall on Friday, producing a 4-5 foot storm surge along the coast near the point of landfall. In addition, heavy rains of 5-10 inches and locally heavier may produce significant flooding along the path of the storm. Isolated tornadoes are also possible.

Tropical Depression 05, with 35 mph winds, is about 350 miles east of the Lesser Antilles, moving west northwest at 15 mph. It may intensify into a tropical storm during today and will likely threaten a portion of the Lesser Antilles tonight o Saturday.

Hurricane Felicia, with 75 mph winds, is well south southwest of southern Baja near 15.1n/120.6w, moving west northwest at 12 mph. Felicia will maintain track and strength during the next 24 hours, threatening only shipping.
